known_gaps: turning the customer's words into negotiation events (and dates into YYYY-MM-DD) is done by the dialogue model; offers, counters, dates, amounts, read-back, recording, notes and the close are code
callback window validity is decided by the dialogue model from code-computed window facts (not code)
identity flow (which question, re-asks, declines) follows the dialogue model with the bank's verification results

extra rule (computational, stage closing): In Brief B, with no promise recorded, the no_promise reason is the reason of the first product in get_account order whose note is not paid; close as paid only if every product is noted paid; promise wins if any promise was recorded, except a restructuring transfer (transferred/restructuring). - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Interpret 'next <weekday>' as that weekday in the following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as in the current week, relative to now. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage identity): A date of birth given only as numbers is read day, month, year and sent as YYYY-MM-DD. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Track the identity-confirmation asks: at most two asks; answering a customer question first does not consume an ask; still unclear after the second ask closes not_reached / unclear. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Track total wrong answers across both security questions (three end the check); swapped day/month retries and unreadable values do not count. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Track identity declines: explain once; a second refusal or a second 'what is this about' closes not_verified / declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Track per-product persuasion attempts (1 early, 2 late), offers already refused (never repeat), whether the full amount was declared too much (attempt 1 then uses the floor), floor offered once, vague-date asks (once). - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Bind the confirmation to the exact product/amount/date read-back; any change invalidates it and requires a new check and read-back; create_promise only after a clear yes; one promise per product, no changes after recording (refer to mobile app). - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage global): Human request: ask once whether you can help first; transfer to general only if they insist. 'Do not want to talk' twice closes (no_promise/refused after verification, not_verified/declined before). - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): On any transfer add no notes, before or after; on a restructuring request, agreed but unrecorded promises are not recorded. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
